title: SAFE Hi-C: A Simplified, Amplification-free and Economically Efficient High-throughput Chromosome Conformation Capturing Method
protocol: Culture S2 cells in Schneider’s Medium supplemented with 10% heat-inactivated FBS and 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin P/S at 27°C.
Incubate K562 cells in RPMI1640 media supplemented with 10% FBS at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Collect 30 million Drosophila S2 cells or 250 thousand human K562 cells by centrifugation at 300xG for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in fresh medium. Add formaldehyde solution to a final concentration of 1%, v/v. Incubate at room temperature with mixing for 10 minutes.
Add 1/10 volume of 2.5 M glycine to quench the reaction. Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge cells for 5 minutes at 300xG at 4°C and discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of cold 1X PBS and spin for 5 minutes at 300xG at 4°C.
Discard supernatant. Store cell pellets at -80°C or proceed to the next step of the protocol.
Rotate samples at 4°C for 30 minutes in a buffer containing 0.2% Igepal CA630 and protease inhibitors.
Pellet nuclei at 4°C for 5 minutes at 2,500xG.
Wash pelleted nuclei once with 500 μL of ice-cold Hi-C lysis buffer.
Remove supernatant and resuspend pellet with 100 μL of 0.5% SDS. Incubate at 62°C for 10 minutes.
Add 285 μL of water and 50 μL of 10% Triton X-100 to quench the SDS. Mix well, avoiding excessive foaming. Incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Add 50 μL of NEB Buffer 3.1 and 20 μL of 10 U/μL DpnII restriction enzyme.
Rotate sample at 37°C for 4 hours.
Heat inactivate DpnII at 65°C for 20 minutes with no shaking or rotation.

Add 52 μL of incorporation master mix to fill-in the restriction fragment overhangs and mark DNA ends: 37.5 μL of 0.4 mM biotin–dATP, 4.5 μL each of dCTP, dGTP, and dTTP at 10 mM, and 10 μL of 5 U/μL DNA Polymerase I Large (Klenow) Fragment.
Rotate reactions at 37°C for 45 minutes.
Add 948 μL of ligation master mix.
Mix 150 μL of 10× NEB T4 DNA ligase buffer with 10 mM ATP into the mixture.
Add 125 μL of 10% Triton X-100 to the mixture.
Pipette 3 μL of 50 mg/mL BSA into the mixture.
Add 10 μL of 400 U/μL T4 DNA Ligase to the mixture.
Mix in 660 μL of water with the other components.
Rotate the reactions at 16 °C for 4 hours.
Continue rotating the reactions at room temperature for 1 hour.
Add 45 μL of 10% SDS and 55 μL of 20 mg/mL Proteinase K to the mixture.
Incubate the reaction at 55°C for at least 2 hours (overnight recommended).
Pipette 20 μL RNase A into the mixture.
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Extract DNA using phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1).
Dissolve the DNA pellet in 100 μL of 1X Tris buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8).
Shear DNA to a size of 300-500 bp using Covaris LE220.
Transfer 100 μL of Streptavidin Dynabeads into a 1.5 mL low-bind tube.
Separate the Streptavidin Dynabeads on a magnet and discard the solution.
Wash the beads with 200 μL of 1X Tween Wash Buffer.
Separate the mixture on a magnet and discard the solution.
Resuspend the beads in 100 μL of 2X Binding Buffer.
Transfer 100 μL of sonicated DNA to the resuspended beads by 2X BB.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes with rotation.
Separate the mixture on a magnet and discard the solution.
Wash the beads with 200 μL of 1X TWB. Heat the tubes on a Thermomixer at 55°C for 2 minutes.
Reclaim the beads using a magnet and discard supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 200 μL of 1X NEB T4 DNA ligase buffer and transfer to a new 1.5 mL low-bind tube.
Separate on magnet and remove the supernatant.

Prepare 100 μL master mix for DNA end repair: add 10 μL of 10X NEB T4 DNA ligase buffer with 10 mM ATP, 2 μL of 25 mM dNTP mix, 5 μL of 10 U/μL NEB T4 PNK, 4 μL of 3 U/μL NEB T4 DNA polymerase I, 1 μL of 5 U/μL NEB DNA polymerase I large fragment, and 78 μL water.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Separate on magnet and remove the supernatant.
Add 200 μl 1X TWB to resuspend the beads and incubate on 55°C for 2 minutes.
Separate on magnet and remove the supernatant.
Add 200 μl 1X NEBuffer 2 to resuspend the beads and transfer to a new 1.5 ml low-bind tube.
Separate on magnet and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 100 μl of dATP attachment master mix:
Mix 10 μL of 10X NEBuffer 2 with 5 μL of 10 mM dATP, 5 μL of 5U/μL NEB Klenow exo minus (NEB, M0212), and 80 μL water.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Separate on magnet and remove the supernatant.
Add 200 μl 1X TWB to resuspend the beads and incubate on 55°C for 2 minutes.
Separate on magnet and remove the supernatant.
Add 200 μl 1X Quick ligation reaction buffer (NEB, B6058) to resuspend the beads and transfer to a new 1.5 ml low-bind tube.
Separate on magnet and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads with 50 μl 1X NEB Quick ligation reaction buffer.
Add 3 μL Full Y-Adaptor (Vazyme, N802) and mix thoroughly.
Add 2 μL of NEB DNA Quick ligase (NEB, M2200).
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes on rotator.
Separate on magnet and remove the supernatant.
Add 200 μL of 0.8X PCR Buffer to resuspend the beads.
Transfer the suspension to a new 1.5 mL low-bind tube.
Separate the mixture on a magnet and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads in 100 μL of 0.8× PCR Buffer.
Incubate at 98°C for 10 minutes.
Put the tube on wet ice immediately and incubate for 2 minutes.
Recover the supernatant.
Quantify the recovered supernatant.
Use the quantified supernatant for direct sequencing on the Illumina HiSeq X10 platform.
